meta.name: eol-internal-enablement
meta.description: Build the support FAQ, sales talking points, and objection handling teams need before an EOL announcement. Use when customer-facing teams must be ready before customers hear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提前备好EOL公告前的支持FAQ与销售话术
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们产品即将停售,需要让客服和销售提前做好问答和话术准备。
copy.tagline_en: Prepare support FAQs and sales talking points before EOL announcements.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product is nearing end-of-life and you need to ready customer-facing teams in advance.

howto.what: 会生成一份内部准备包,内容随影响级别变化:基础是支持 FAQ(内含带名字/触发条件的升级路径);标准级及以上再含销售对比话术与认可-重构-提供异议处理;重级另增渠道简报和培训大纲。
howto.when: 当产品或功能即将停用,需要在对外公告前、客户还没听说时先让支持与销售团队做好准备时触发。

say.text: 旧版模块 12 月 31 日停用,替代品是新面板,给内部团队做套准备材料。
say.note: 会先按影响面定级,再生成对应材料。

say.text: 功能弃用、无替代品,只做支持 FAQ,提前三周通知。
say.note: 只产出约10-15条问答的支持FAQ。

say.text: 客户可能刚续约就遇到停用,帮我起草异议处理话术。
say.note: 按认可-重构-提供写出答复模板。

howto.what_en: Creates impact-sized EOL pack: FAQ base includes named escalation path/triggers; standard+ adds sales talking points and Acknowledge-Reframe-Offer objection handling; heavy adds channel brief and training outline.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a product/feature is approaching EOL and customer-facing teams must be ready with FAQs and talking points before the announcement reaches customers.

say_en.text: Legacy module EOL Dec 31, new dashboard replaces it. Build internal pack.
say_en.note: Picks impact tier, builds FAQ, sales talk track, objections.

say_en.text: Feature deprecation, no replacement, support FAQ only, 3-week notice.
Customers may say they just renewed; draft objection handling.
